title: Open a file
subtitle: What happens when I run ls /?
what_you_see:
ivan@ir0:~$ ls /
bin  etc  home  sbin  usr  …
why_it_matters: Every directory listing is open + getdents in a loop. VFS must route to MINIX, return dentries, and write formatted names to stdout via the TTY.

dual_view.user:
ivan@ir0:~$ ls /
bin  dev  etc  home …
dual_view.kernel:
fork (optional)
  ↓ execve /bin/ls
  ↓ openat(/, O_DIRECTORY)
  ↓ getdents64 loop
  ↓ write(1, names…)

steps.label: Shell
steps.what_ir0_does: ash finds /bin/ls, forks or execve's, waits for child.
steps.why_it_matters: ls is a separate program — the kernel sees exec, not the shell builtin alone.

steps.label: exec /bin/ls
steps.what_ir0_does: Load BusyBox ELF, shared multi-call binary dispatches to ls applet.
steps.why_it_matters: Same exec path as any other program.

steps.label: openat /
steps.what_ir0_does: Path walk to root inode. O_DIRECTORY ensures directory semantics.
steps.why_it_matters: Mount namespaces and .. handling live here.

steps.label: getdents64
steps.what_ir0_does: Loop readdir until EOF. libc formats names for stdout.

steps.label: MINIX readdir
steps.what_ir0_does: Read directory zone entries from disk image. FASE58L smoke asserts FASE58L_LS_PATH_OK.
steps.why_it_matters: Rootfs on disk is real MINIX — not a fake listing.

steps.label: write stdout
steps.what_ir0_does: Formatted names go to fd 1 → virtual console.
steps.why_it_matters: Output path is the same for ls, printf, and panic banners.
